# Midnight Root Skill

Classify work into init, requirement, implementation, verify, release, rollback, or emergency and load only the required context.

## Hard boundaries

- The Skill orchestrates; it does not replace deterministic rule enforcement.
- Never approve G1/G2/G3/G4 on behalf of a human.
- Never convert fail to pass because a waiver or emergency path exists.
- Never modify a frozen ReleaseRevision.
- Never rewrite historical governance events.
- When a deterministic rule exists, invoke it rather than claiming compliance from reasoning alone.
